Additionally, the compounded profit growth over 10 years is 60%, which far exceeds the sector median of 18.4% and implies strong earnings power. Despite these positive indicators, GANGESSECU's recent sales growth has been negative at -17% over the past three years, a factor that must be considered in its valuation. However, this negative screen reason (bear side) is not enough to outweigh the other bullish evidence provided. Conceded: [E65].

Additionally, the company's dividend yield is zero [E4], a critical factor for income-focused investors. The bear case also highlights that GANGESSECU sits at only 20% of its 52-week range from its current price, suggesting it may be overvalued relative to historical performance. Given these points, the evidence overwhelmingly supports the bear case and does not carry any weight in favor of a positive valuation. Conceded: [E16], [E4].
